items.html: And just as it is the matter of the bending of the head of Arich Anpin in order to add NHY to Aba and Ima, so too, through the bending of the head, Arich Anpin adds the aspect of Yesod to ZA. But there is a difference between them: to give NHY to Aba and Ima, Arich Anpin must bend his head, along with all the Tikunim that are from the eighth Mazal until the thirteenth Mazal. But to give the aspect of Yesod alone to ZA, there is no need except for him to bend his head in the aspect of that last thirteenth Mazal alone, which is also the aspect of the Yesod of the beard of Arich Anpin, and it descends to the head of ZA literally; then it influences a great light of influence upon the Mochin of ZA, and from there a great light is drawn below, and the aspect of Yesod is added to him.
